content.content: When invoked as `deccy record --to <id>` naming no path, the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation and place nothing.
content.rationale: The form names the edits to place — `deccy record <path>... --to <id>` — so an invocation that names none cannot place what it promises. Refusing the empty object mirrors the missing purpose: the two parts D13 makes required refuse the same way, before anything moves.
